annotations.title: Promote one-time commitments to a recurring one

description: Takes the ids of one-time commitments that are one thing repeating and makes one recurring commitment: their charges move under it exactly as they are — dates, amounts, paid, basis — the one-time rows go, and the plan continues from the step after the latest, never before today, for plan_months (24 by default), or stops at ends_on for a repeat that has ended. Attributes start as the first row's, direction included, so money in stays money in and a transfer stays a transfer; ids that do not share one direction are refused. Name, tag, member, account and notes may be given; notes are the commitment's three details that matter, one per line. Where writes are proposals, a row is promotable once the owner's app has applied it and commitments shows its id. Every id must be a one-time commitment the memory holds; a miss answers with the real names. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Proposals screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.

custom_cycle_days.description: The days between charges of a custom cycle: a whole number, 1 to 36,500.

guide_key.description: The guide_key read_guide returned with the prompt or chapter this write follows.

notes.description: The three details that matter most, one per line, each "Label: value" — for insurance "Policy number: …", "Policy name: …", "Document: documents/…". Only what the source states; read_guide "notes" lists the three by category. Card numbers, whole account numbers and credentials are refused.
